title.narrative: Programmatic framework for inclusive and sustainable industrial development - Country Programme Cuba 2021-2025

description.narrative: UNIDO is supporting Cuba#s efforts for ISID and strengthening its industrial capabilities and competitiveness in priority industrial sectors through the formulation of a Country Programme (CP) 2021-2025 as requested by the Government, and in line with the National Plan for Economic and Social Development until 2030 and the UNSDCF 2020-2024. The Cuban Government, in order to achieve Inclusive and Sustainable Industrial Development, has identified the prioritized sectors and has requested UNIDO for support in the following areas: # Enhanced use of renewable energy sources and efficient use of energy. # Promote pharmaceutical and biotechnological industrial development. # Promote productive value chain programs and their integration into international markets. # Strengthen the capacity of key actors in agro-industrial systems that facilitate the increase and diversification of production. # Support the development of Industrial Technology Parks and Special Economic Zones.
